title: BiGSyn: A Bi-Level Heterogeneous Graph Contrastive Learning Framework for Interpretable Drug Synergy Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.20603v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Drug combination therapy has become a mainstream of modern medicine, with the potential to enhance efficacy, reduce toxicity, and overcome drug resistance. However, identifying synergistic drug combinations remains challenging, as it requires modeling complex interactions across multiple biological scales---from atom-level molecular structures to entity-level relations in biological networks. Existing approaches typically model these levels in isolation, overlooking complementary signals and long-range dependencies. To address these limitations, we propose BiGSyn, a Bi-level heterogeneous Graph contrastive learning framework for drug Synergy prediction. Specifically, BiGSyn leverages heterogeneous graph transformers to extract high-order dependencies from molecular graphs and biological networks, and introduces a bi-level contrastive learning objective to bridge the cross-level semantic gap. Extensive experiments on two benchmark dataset

translated_title: BiGSyn：一种用于可解释药物协同预测的双层异构图对比学习框架
translated_abstract: 药物联合疗法已成为现代医学的主流，具有增强疗效、降低毒性并克服耐药性的潜力。然而，识别具有协同效应的药物组合仍然具有挑战性，因为这需要对跨越多个生物尺度的复杂交互进行建模——从原子级的分子结构到生物网络中的实体级关系。现有方法通常孤立地对这些层级进行建模，忽略了互补信号和长程依赖关系。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了BiGSyn，一个用于药物协同预测的双层异构图对比学习框架。具体而言，BiGSyn利用异构图Transformer从分子图和生物网络中提取高阶依赖关系，并引入双层对比学习目标来弥合跨层级的语义鸿沟。我们在两个基准数据集上进行了大量实验（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出双层异构图对比学习框架BiGSyn，利用异构图Transformer联合建模原子级分子结构与生物网络实体级关系，通过双层对比学习目标弥合跨尺度语义鸿沟，实现可解释的药物协同效应预测。
